business_problem: But in today’s payments landscape, where global scale increases both opportunity and exposure, Envisso’s legacy infrastructure was slowing the company down. Siloed data, limited visibility into lineage and manual processes made it harder to deliver instant risk intelligence.
solution_summary: Envisso uses data to turn the management of merchant risk into a profit driver. Their AI-powered monitoring platform and first-of-its-kind payments insurance solution enable partners to process transactions confidently and securely, providing efficiency and peace of mind to both payment companies and merchants. But in today’s payments landscape, where global scale increases both opportunity and exposure, Envisso’s legacy infrastructure was slowing the company down. Siloed data, limited visibility into lineage and manual processes made it harder to deliver instant risk intelligence. In an environment that requires speed and precision, Envisso needed a platform that could ingest and analyze vast amounts of merchant, transaction and dispute data — while keeping governance and security intact. Turning to the Databricks Data + AI Platform, Envisso now has a unified foundation for data, analytics and AI to mitigate merchant risk more efficiently and accelerate growth.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores curated lakehouse tables used for reliable downstream analytics and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Delta Sharing
solution_components.role: Delivers governed data access across agencies, partners, or business units without copying datasets.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Applies centralized governance, lineage, and access controls across shared data assets.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow Jobs
solution_components.role: Schedules and orchestrates recurring data pipelines and production jobs.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow
solution_components.role: Coordinates ingestion and transformation workflows across the lakehouse.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, self-service queries, and business intelligence for downstream users.

data_flow: Transaction, dispute, and event data lands in Databricks, is transformed in Delta Lake tables under Unity Catalog governance, with pipelines coordinated through Databricks orchestration and transformation services, and is served to downstream users and applications through Databricks SQL, Delta Sharing.
business_outcome: Reported outcomes include 1 day Time to onboard; 2x–0 New headcount.
